title: Repair governed dev paper baseline safe early-failure replay
summary_zh: 依 Root 早期審查回饋（ai-status.json next 04:52 UTC）嚴格修訂：撤銷先前試圖由 current_step 截取 failed_step 之相容性 fallback，避免放寬未知／缺失 error 之 retry 分類而削弱 fail-closed 邊界；唯讀 Postgres 鑑識 readback（prior-bootstrap-forensic-readback.json）證實 live 資料庫記錄之 error.failed_step 確實為 capital_pool，且既有 PersonaProvisioningCoordinator._is_safe_early_failure 謂詞於該記錄直接求值為 True。在 test_persona_provisioning_coordinator.py 與 test_persona_owner_packaged_transport.py 建立完整回歸測試，以完全相同的歷史失敗 ledger（error.failed_step='capital_pool'、references={}、compensation=None、attempt_count=4）重現真實 packaged route /bff/management/personas/create-paper-bundle，證明 safe early failure 順利安全重播至 schedule_registered（HTTP 201 Created，attempt_count 推進至 5，references 寫入完整 binding/deployment/schedule），並於獨立新 process durable readback 驗證持久化；同時新增 fail-closed 邊界測試，證明包含已提交 binding side effects（如 persona_capital_binding_created）或非空 compensation 之記錄必定嚴格拒絕重播（502 UPSTREAM_ERROR）。針對 run 33943312084 於部署 candidate image d86886… 時為何回傳 502，因該 image 於失敗補償後未保留於 VM image store 無法進行逐 byte 容器鑑識，本報告如實陳述該不確定性（可能因背景 reconciler 短暫持有 lease 或容器環境特定差異），不捏造無根據的相容層修補。以 DRAFT PR 交付，不自行 merge 或修改 hosted 狀態。

owned: Strict fail-closed preservation: reverted speculative current_step[:-len("_failed")] fallback in coordinator and router to prevent broadening safe retry classification to unclassified or missing-error records.

Exact ledger reproduction regression: added test_safe_early_failure_name_error_capital_pool_replays_successfully in test_persona_provisioning_coordinator.py and test_packaged_route_safe_early_name_error_replay_fresh_process in test_persona_owner_packaged_transport.py, reproducing the exact historical failed ledger (error.failed_step="capital_pool", error_type="NameError", terminal_reason="name 'urllib_error' is not defined", references={}, compensation=None, attempt_count=4) through the packaged route to prove safe early replay completes to schedule_registered (201 Created) with durable multi-store readback.

Fail-closed boundary enforcement: added test_safe_early_failure_rejects_unsafe_binding_side_effects and test_safe_early_failure_rejects_non_null_compensation in coordinator tests, and test_packaged_route_rejects_unsafe_binding_side_effects_fresh_process in transport tests, proving that any committed binding side effects (persona_capital_binding_created) or non-null compensation are strictly rejected with 502 UPSTREAM_ERROR and never forward retried.

Package import alignment: updated test_persona_provisioning_coordinator.py to import services.control_plane.bff.persona_provisioning* via package root, resolving standalone collection failures while preserving package boundaries.
not_changing: No hosted mutations or database edits to tenant-dev or persona-d57f6d76254c20418a9e.
No alteration of fixed bootstrap IDs (dev-paper-bootstrap-20260720-operator-a-v3) or parameters.
No modification of services/persona (owned by Claude under DEV-PERSONA-AUTHORITY-20260905).

known_gap: Forensic certainty on historical record: readback prior-bootstrap-forensic-readback.json shows the actual Postgres row has error.failed_step="capital_pool", references={}, compensation=null, and pure PersonaProvisioningCoordinator._is_safe_early_failure evaluates to True.

Forensic uncertainty on run 33943312084: in run 33943312084, deployed candidate image d86886… returned 502 with precondition_failed="capital_pool" without advancing failed_at (remained 2026-09-04T11:52:48Z). Because candidate image d86886… was discarded during deploy compensation and not preserved in the VM image store, byte-level container execution cannot be forensically replayed. Hypotheses include transient lease acquisition contention with the periodic _persona_provisioning_reconciler_loop (which increments attempt_count and updates updated_at) or container package resolution. We report this uncertainty directly rather than claiming generic workarounds fix the run.
